meta.title: Contrepoint acoustique — Tabula Rasa loudspeakers
meta.description: Discover Tabula Rasa full-range loudspeakers by Contrepoint acoustique, designed and made in France for pure, precise and natural sound.

line-03.title: “Honesty, utility, simplicity.”
paragraphs: The essence of our open-baffle loudspeakers invites faith in sonic integrity and formal purity, where function shapes form. A design that favors clarity and depth over brute power.

line-04.title: “Art doesn’t have to function, but design does.”
paragraphs: Our approach draws on the ethos of minimal art. The goal is to focus on the essential, removing unnecessary details or distractions. This is the starting point of our approach: reproducing a sound work without artifacts.

line-05.title: Music set free
paragraphs:
A single driver reproduces bass, midrange, and treble. It is therefore a point source, resulting in exemplary image precision and timbral consistency.

No crossover.
“There is no such thing as a good component. All components are bad. The only good thing is nothing.”
Richard Dunn, founder of NVA Audio.

The driver used is high-efficiency and requires little power for home listening.

This technology promotes fast transients and microdynamics, resulting in unparalleled liveliness and vitality.

line-06.title: Sonic transparency
paragraphs:
We solve problems by removing their causes, stripping the object of the dross that clutters it. One driver, no cabinet, no electronic components.

No enclosure, but an acrylic panel thanks to a purpose-built driver. PMMA is inherently low-resonance, and the open-baffle design also makes it possible to radically free the sound from standing waves.

line-07.title: The voice is sublime
paragraphs:
Tabula rasa offers a high degree of resolution but without listening fatigue; on the contrary, the sound is smooth and nuanced.

They favor delicacy of reproduction over spectacular effect.

line-08.title: Choosing quality
paragraphs:
An amplifier of the highest quality is essential; power matters little: a few watts are enough.
We can point you toward perfectly suitable models.

specs.taxNote: * VAT not applicable, Article 293 B of the French General Tax Code
specs.sustainableBody: No planned obsolescence, with durability at the heart of our concerns. Recycled and recyclable acrylic glass, combined with a paper speaker cone. Designed and manufactured in France with care and precision.
specs.technicalBody: A 22.5 cm full-range driver is a point source. Its impedance is 8 Ω and its break-in period is 50 hours. It works with tube amplifiers delivering only 2 or 3 W and accepts up to 50 W with tube or solid-state amplification.
specs.usageNote: This is not a sound system. Listening is intended for home use, offering a pure and intimate sound experience.
